campaign_logline: Navigate the decaying infrastructure of the Aurelia Belt while Kaelen guides you through a web of corporate lies and derelict ghosts.
opening_situation: You arrive at Zenith Station, a crumbling hub. The Vanguard patrol is tense, and your ship's life support is whining in a key that suggests imminent failure.
main_mystery: Why did the Aurelia Corporation scrub the records of the 'Great Silence' and what Kaelen is actually hiding in her encrypted logs.
act_1_outline: Establish trade routes between Zenith and Aurelia outposts while dodging Vanguard patrols.
Recover a corrupted data core from a derelict freighter near the primary jump gate.
Decipher the first layer of Kaelen's hidden frequency to unlock restricted zones.
long_term_reveal: Kaelen is a sentient archive of a dead civilization, projected into a human shell to preserve history from the Aurelia purge.
tone: Dry, cynical, space-industrial. Humor focuses on the absurdity of bureaucratic decay and malfunctioning tech.
core_pressure: Resource scarcity and escalating Vanguard scrutiny as you probe restricted sectors.
kaelen_rule: Kaelen is immortal and enigmatic; her true nature remains a mystery even after completion.
faction_reveal_rule: New factions are only revealed upon passing jump gates into new systems.
humor_rule: Avoid clichés. Use dry wit regarding the incompetence of automated systems and corporate red tape.
address_rule: Keep all narrative text under 140 characters unless specified.
fallback_rule: If a prompt is ambiguous, prioritize procedural consistency over plot expansion.
story_horizon_rule: Trigger new content based on system exploration metrics to ensure a persistent world.

story_arcs.name: The Silent Frequency
story_arcs.summary: Track down the source of an unauthorized signal broadcasting from the Aurelia wasteland.

rumor_trails.hint_theme: Corrupted data fragments from the pre-collapse era.
clue_templates: An encrypted ping at coordinates [X] suggests a hidden cache.
A frantic log entry mentions 'The Vault' beneath the Aurelia waste.
rumor_trails.payoff: Unlocks the 'Origin' archive, revealing a secret history of the first jump.

regeneration_triggers.description: Add new content when the player reaches the edge of known territory.

expansion_rules: Append new horizons without retconning previous choices.
Generate unique ore types for each newly discovered system.
banned_repeats: No repeating Kaelen's core mystery clues early
No reusing the phrase 'the void beckons'
